skins.name: Witch's Swing
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/Witch's Swing. She plays the role of the young witch brought by her dark mistress to gain some experience! Who says a witch's swing has to be a broom? A chainsaw works too!
skins.quote: Wait! Someone stop her! Why's she running around on her chainsaw like it's a broom?! The training room floor can't take any more!
